attestations.text: HSÜ Yüan-wên 徐元文 (T. 公肅, H. 立齋), Nov. 18, 1634–1691, Aug. 20, official, younger brother of Hsü Ch'ien-hsüeh [q. v.], was a native of K'un-shan, Kiangsu. In 1659 he was the highest ranking chin-shih, known as chuang-yüan, and was given the rank of compiler of the first class in the Hanlin Academy.
徐元文，字公肅，江西崑山人。

accounts.evidence: 徐元文，字公肅，江西崑山人。初冒姓陸，通籍後復姓。少沉潛好學，與兄乾學、弟秉義有聲於時，稱為「三徐」。
